name: AVIF Studio - Image Editor With AVIF Support
description: Extension for image editing and annotation. Save image in various formats. AVIF, WEBP, JPG, PNG, and ICO image formats are supported
author: Shareej V K

content_security_policy.extension_pages: style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https: file:; connect-src 'self' data:; default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval';
